source: interface IItem {public int V {get;}}
class Item:IItem {public int V=0;}
class Derived:Item {}
class Other:IItem {public int V=2;}

class Bag {public List<IItem?> Items=[]; public bool ReadItems(){return Items.Count==2 && Items[0]==null && Items[1]!.V==7;} public bool RemoveNull(){Items.Remove(null); return Items.Count==1 && Items[0]!.V==7;} }
class RequiredBag {public List<IItem> Items=[];}
class Outer {public List<Bag> Bags=[];}
class FieldBag {public IItem? Value=null; public List<IItem> Items=[];}
class GenericBag<T extends IItem> {public List<T> Items=[];}
interface IText<T> {public T Value {get;}}
class TextItem<T>:IText<T> {public T Value;}
class TextBag {public List<IText<string>?> Items=[];}
class Probe {

public static bool Original(){Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Add(new Item()); bool found=b.Items.Contains(null)&&b.Items.IndexOf(null)==0; b.Items.Remove(null); return found&&b.Items.Count==1;}
public static bool NonNull(){Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(new Item(){V=7}); b.Items.Add(new Item(){V=8}); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items[0]!.V==7 && b.Items[1]!.V==8;}
public static bool NullOnly(){Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==0;}
public static bool Empty(){Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==0;}
public static bool Initializer(){Bag b=new Bag(){Items=[new Item(){V=7},null]}; b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==1 && b.Items[0]!.V==7;}
public static bool NullFirst(){Bag b=new Bag(){Items=[null,new Item(){V=7},null]}; b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==2 && b.Items[0]!.V==7 && b.Items[1]==null;}
public static bool Identity(){Item i=new Item(){V=7}; Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(i); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); i.V=9; return b.Items[0]==i && b.Items[0]!.V==9;}
public static bool NonNullable(){RequiredBag b=new RequiredBag(); b.Items.Add(new Item(){V=7}); b.Items.Clear(); return b.Items.Count==0;}
public static bool Inherited(){Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(new Derived(){V=8}); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items[0]!.V==8;}
public static bool TwoImplementers(){Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(new Item(){V=1}); b.Items.Add(new Other(){V=2}); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items[0]!.V+b.Items[1]!.V==3;}
public static bool Nested(){Outer o=new Outer(); o.Bags.Add(new Bag(){Items=[new Item(){V=7},null]}); o.Bags[0].Items.Remove(null); return o.Bags[0].Items[0]!.V==7;}
public static bool Field(){FieldBag b=new FieldBag(){Value=new Item(){V=7}}; b.Items.Add(new Item()); b.Items.Clear(); return b.Value!.V==7;}
public static bool Generic(){GenericBag<Item> b=new GenericBag<Item>(); b.Items.Add(new Item(){V=7}); b.Items.Clear(); return b.Items.Count==0;}
public static bool GenericImplementer(){TextBag b=new TextBag(); b.Items.Add(new TextItem<string>(){Value="yes"}); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items[0]!.Value=="yes";}
public static Bag CreateBag(){Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Add(new Item(){V=7}); return b;}
